personalInfo.name: Sahil Bansal
personalInfo.title: Software Engineer - DevOps & Cloud Infrastructure
personalInfo.tagline: Focused on infrastructure automation, reliability, and cost-efficient cloud systems

summary: DevOps / Cloud Engineer with 3 years of global remote experience owning production AWS infrastructure end-to-end, from architecture through on-call. Delivered $40K/year in cloud cost savings, cut provisioning time by 70%, and accelerated 30% faster deployment cycles through IaC-first automation and high-leverage CI/CD redesigns. Equally effective owning the reliability contract through SLOs, alerting, and incident response, and the developer experience through pipeline design, security gates, and self-service platform tooling. Core strengths: AWS (ECS, RDS, VPC, IAM), Terraform, GitHub Actions, container security, and data-platform engineering.

experience.title: DevOps Engineer
bullets: Saved $40K/year (40% AWS spend reduction) by adopting Fargate Spot, Savings Plans, eliminating unused resources and ECS task right-sizing across 20+ services, validated against SLO dashboards with zero reliability regression.
Cut environment provisioning time by 70% by architecting a Terraform-first IaC platform covering 100% of ECS, RDS, SQS, IAM, and VPC resources across 4 environments in reusable, versioned modules.

Accelerated deployment frequency by 30% by overhauling GitHub Actions CI/CD across 20+ repositories, introducing parallelized test stages, PR-scoped smoke tests, and semantic versioning, reducing average pipeline duration from 15 min to 6 min.

Sustained 99.99% availability on a multi-tenant FTP ingestion platform processing 1000+ requests/day for 100+ global suppliers, enforcing per-tenant isolation, per-user credentials, and full API audit trails.
Reduced analytics query latency from minutes to milliseconds by designing a real-time ELT lakehouse from MySQL and MongoDB into ClickHouse via Dagster and DLT, powering executive dashboards.

Eliminated long-lived credentials org-wide by enforcing AWS IAM Identity Center (SSO) across 30 accounts/roles and authoring least-privilege IAM policies; implemented service-level observability with Prometheus, Grafana, and ECS deployment alerting.
Executed zero-downtime Auth0 tenant migration for 1,000+ user accounts during a corporate rebrand with no password resets and no user impact.

experience.title: DevOps Analyst
bullets: Raised deployment success rate by 15% by refactoring monolithic CI/CD pipelines into modular, independently failing stages with targeted fault isolation.
Cut incident response time by 20% by integrating Prometheus alerting with a Slack-based on-call workflow, replacing manual triage.

experience.title: Software Engineer - DevOps
bullets: Blocked 95% of critical CVEs from reaching production by embedding container security gates into AWS CodeBuild pipelines as hard-fail quality gates enforcing a zero-tolerance policy on HIGH and CRITICAL severity findings.
Improved log query performance by 30% and reduced per-GB storage cost by 45% by migrating centralized logging from EBS-backed volumes to AWS EFS, enabling elastic scaling without pre-provisioning.
